title: Ubuntu swap: the local connection enters your m21 registry by configuration
purpose: The m24-3 command surface for Ubuntu 24.04 (Cells D and E): merge the local connection profile, run the unchanged application through hosted-or-fallback and local routes, and save checksum evidence that the application-code diff is empty. Assumes your m24-2 LocalProviderAdapter passes the shared contract suite and is registered in your registry; writing that adapter is the lesson, not this recipe. Status is CANARY: authored 2026-07-25 from the verified Cell A record (the commands are identical on bash), not yet executed on a real Ubuntu machine; it flips to current after a start-to-finish on-OS run. The pinned model's thinking behavior and its handling are documented below because they are the protocol deviation you will meet first.
hardware_class: Cell D or E (either Ubuntu runtime cell)
runtime_version: 0.20.2 (version verified on Cell A; record this cell's at verify)
prerequisites: The Cell D or Cell E runtime recipe completed: service running, model pulled
Your Module 21 project with the canonical types, registry, and contract suite
Your Module 24 LocalProviderAdapter registered under adapter ID local

steps.purpose: Probe the service before you involve the application, so you know which side failed.
steps.expected_output: A JSON model list including qwen3.5:2b.
common_errors: Connection refused: start the runtime service first (runtime recipe, step 1).

steps.purpose: Gate on the contract suite: an adapter that has not passed does not get picked.
steps.expected_output: Every contract test passes, including the shared suite running against your local adapter. Record the suite file's checksum for the evidence.
steps.undo: Nothing to undo; tests write no state.
common_errors: Failures in normalized-error tests: your adapter maps the runtime's errors incompletely; fix the adapter, never the suite.

steps.purpose: Merge the local connection profile into your registry configuration, with a backup for the rollback step.
steps.command: cp src/profiles.json src/profiles.json.bak && python3 -c "import json; p=json.load(open('src/profiles.json')); p['local_real']={'adapter':'local','base_url':'http://127.0.0.1:11434','model':'qwen3.5:2b','privacy_class':'local-only','secret_env':None}; json.dump(p, open('src/profiles.json','w'), indent=2)"
steps.expected_output: No output; profiles.json now contains local_real and the backup exists.
steps.undo: mv src/profiles.json.bak src/profiles.json restores the pre-merge registry.
common_errors: KeyError or missing file: run from the project root that holds src/profiles.json.

steps.purpose: Run the UNCHANGED application through the local route by configuration alone.
steps.expected_output: connection: local_real, profile: adapter=local privacy_class=local-only, then a real content sentence with finish_reason complete and canonical usage fields. On Cell A the warm response took about half a second; record this cell's timing at verify.
steps.undo: Nothing to undo; the run writes no state.
common_errors: Empty content with finish_reason length: the pinned model THINKS by default and the thinking consumed your output-token budget. Your adapter must send reasoning_effort none on the OpenAI-compatible route (or think false on the native route). This is the m24-1 lesson arriving on schedule: compatible is a claim you test.
failed: not_found: the profile model does not match a pulled model; check ollama list.

steps.purpose: Capture the checksum evidence: same application bytes on every route.
steps.expected_output: Two checksums; the app checksum matches the value recorded before the merge, so the application-code diff is empty. Save both with the run outputs in your swap evidence.

steps.purpose: Prove the reversal: the previous route works again by configuration alone.
steps.expected_output: connection: fallback with the deterministic connection's output. The route change is one environment variable in both directions.
steps.undo: Restore the registry backup (step 3 undo) if you want the pre-merge state back; otherwise keep local_real for the eval recipe.

health_check: CWV_CONNECTION=local_real python3 app_swap_demo.py answers with adapter=local and finish_reason complete
expected_result: DESK EXPECTATION pending on-OS verify: the same application file, byte for byte, answers through the local connection and back through the previous one with only CWV_CONNECTION changing. Evidence saved: profile, adapter ID, suite checksum, app checksum, canonical responses, empty diff.
expected_memory: the loaded model's footprint from the runtime recipe; the swap itself adds nothing
validated_context: 4096, inherited from the runtime recipe (Cell A validated; revalidate at verify)
privacy_notes: The local_real profile carries privacy_class local-only and secret_env null; there is no credential on this route.
No network use beyond loopback in any step of this recipe.
known_failures: Thinking-by-default consumes capped token budgets on the compat route; see step 4 common errors.
An adapter registered but failing the suite: the swap is blocked by design until the suite passes.
